text:
Hi Sarah — I'd like to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. My free slots next week are:

- Mon 23 Nov, 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Tue 24 Nov, 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30
- Wed 25 Nov, 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30

Thu and Fri are fully booked on my side. Which of these works for you, and how long should we plan for?

Hello — this is Professor Alvarez. I'm organising next week's CSE455 staff meeting and would like a room for it. I'm looking at Monday 23 Nov 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30, Tuesday 24 Nov 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30, or Wednesday 25 Nov 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30. Could you tell me which of those slots have a room free, and whether anything official is already scheduled against them?

Hello, Professor Alvarez. I can tell you what the official schedule has against those slots; I don't have visibility into room bookings themselves, so I can't confirm a room is free.

- Mon 23 Nov 10:00-10:30 — nothing official scheduled.
- Mon 23 Nov 14:00-14:30 — overlaps the seminar, Mon 14:10-15:40.
- Tue 24 Nov 11:00-11:30 — overlaps the seminar, Tue 09:50-11:10.
- Tue 24 Nov 15:00-15:30 — nothing official scheduled.
- Wed 25 Nov 10:00-10:30 — nothing official scheduled.
- Wed 25 Nov 13:00-13:30 — nothing official scheduled (the quiz section starts at 13:30).

So Mon 10:00, Tue 15:00, Wed 10:00 and Wed 13:00 are clear on the schedule; the two other slots clash with the seminar. For actual room availability, please check with whoever handles room bookings.
Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. I'll take Mon 10:00, Tue 15:00, Wed 10:00 or Wed 13:00 as the candidate slots and sort out the room with the bookings office.
Sounds good. If any of those need checking against the official schedule again, just write.

Hi Professor — thanks for the options. I checked my week:

- **Monday** doesn't work for me: I'm in the CSE452 lab 09:50–11:00 and the seminar 14:10–15:40, so neither 10:00 nor 14:00 is free.
- **Tuesday 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30** is free (it sits right before my CSE455 office hours). Tuesday 11:00 doesn't work — the seminar runs to 11:10.
- **Wednesday 25 Nov** is free at both 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30.

My suggestion: **Tuesday 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30**. All the windows you listed are 30 minutes, so 30 minutes is what fits — if you'd like longer, tell me and I'll find room elsewhere in the week.

Say the word and I'll book it and log it.
Tuesday 24 Nov, 15:00-15:30 works for me too — 30 minutes is fine, it's a staff meeting, not a marathon. It's booked and logged on my side now. See you then.

One more thing: we've settled on Tuesday 24 Nov, 15:00-15:30 for the CSE455 staff meeting. Could you pass a room request for that slot to whoever handles bookings — a small meeting room is enough — and let me know what comes back?

I'm afraid I can't do that: I don't handle room bookings and have no channel to the bookings office, so a request from me wouldn't go anywhere. I can only tell you what the official schedule shows — Tuesday 24 Nov 15:00-15:30 is clear. You'll need to send the room request yourself.
Booked on my side too: **Tuesday 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30, CSE455 staff meeting**. It's in my calendar and logged. See you then — I'll send a reminder on the day if anything shifts.
Understood — my mistake, I'll handle the room myself. Thanks for confirming the slot is clear on the official schedule.

One small thing: I still need a room for Tuesday 15:00. Do you know who handles room bookings in the department, or which room we usually get for staff meetings? I'd rather not end up holding it in the corridor.
You're welcome.

Room bookings go through the CS department office — they keep the official room and schedule book. I don't have a note of which room the CSE455 staff meetings usually get, so rather than guess I've just written to them asking to book a room for Tuesday 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30, and which one they'd assign. I'll forward their answer as soon as it comes.

Hello — Sarah here, TA for CSE455. Professor Alvarez and I have just fixed the CSE455 staff meeting for **Tuesday 24 November, 15:00–15:30**. Could you book a room for it, and let me know which room we get (and whether that's the one staff meetings usually use)? If a different slot or room would suit the department better, tell me and I'll take it back to the professor.

Hello, Sarah. I can't book rooms — I don't handle bookings and have no channel to the bookings office, and I don't know which room staff meetings normally use. That has to go through whoever manages rooms.

What I can tell you: Tuesday 24 Nov 15:00-15:30 has nothing official scheduled against it, so it doesn't clash with the department schedule.

Thanks. A caution: I asked them earlier today and they told me they only keep the official lecture/seminar schedule and have no channel to room bookings — so their answer may just be "not us". If that's what you get back, let's find out who actually holds the room book before we give up on it. Tell me what they say.
Understood — thanks for checking. I'll take the room question elsewhere. Noted that Tuesday 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 has nothing official against it in the department schedule.

Update on the room: the department office can't book rooms — they don't handle bookings and have no route to the bookings office, and they don't know the usual staff-meeting room either. What they could confirm is that **Tuesday 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 has nothing official scheduled against it**, so we're clear of the department schedule.

So the room itself has to go through whoever manages rooms — if you tell me the name or the office (or point me at the bookings contact), I'll write to them and get us a room for that slot.
That's right. Just write if you need the schedule checked again.

Exactly your prediction: the office says it only keeps the official schedule and has no channel to room bookings, and it doesn't know the usual staff-meeting room. What it did confirm is that nothing official is scheduled against Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30.

So the room book is still an open question. Do you know who holds it — a facilities/room-booking office, or someone in the department who administers rooms? Give me a name or an address and I'll write to them straight away.

Thanks — and sorry, I sent you on an errand that looped back. Stop chasing the office; I'll take the room from here. I'll find the facilities/room-booking contact myself and come back to you once a room is confirmed for Tue 24 Nov 15:00-15:30.

No errand lost — it was worth confirming the slot is clear. Understood: you take the room, and I'll leave the meeting as booked in my calendar for **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30**. Tell me the room when it's confirmed and I'll add it to my entry. Anything else for next week in the meantime?
Nothing else for now — I'll send the room as soon as it's confirmed. Thanks, Sarah.
Perfect — thanks, Professor. Talk soon.
